documents.title: Synthetic workshop cancellation policy
documents.text: Synthetic fixture cancellation policy: cancel a workshop booking at least 7 calendar days before the event for a full refund. Cancellations fewer than 7 days before the event are refundable only according to the booking terms.

documents.title: Synthetic workshop catering options
documents.text: Synthetic fixture catering options: the standard package includes vegetarian and non-vegetarian lunch, tea, and coffee. Dietary requests should be submitted with the booking.

documents.title: Synthetic workshop venue options
documents.text:
Venue A in Pune accommodates up to 30 attendees. Venue A includes a projector and a small breakout room.

Venue B in Pune accommodates up to 40 attendees and includes a projector. Availability must be confirmed separately.
